name: Revenue per day
definition: Product sales after discounts, before refunds, excluding shipping and tax.
rules: Exclude cancelled orders. Use the store timezone for order_date.
why_it_matters: Top-line health. Compare to the prior 7 days.

name: Orders per day
rules: Exclude cancelled. Count on_hold orders (they are real demand).

name: Average order value
why_it_matters: Shows effect of discounts and bundling.

name: Conversion rate
rules: Sessions from GA4 or Shopify analytics. Be consistent about which one you use.
why_it_matters: Early signal of traffic quality or site problems.

name: Marketing efficiency ratio (blended ROAS)
definition: Total revenue divided by total ad spend across all platforms.
rules: Use Shopify revenue, never platform-reported revenue. Spend in one currency.
why_it_matters: The one ad number that is not distorted by platform attribution.

name: Blended customer acquisition cost
definition: Ad spend divided by new customers.
rules: New customer = first order ever. Does not include agency or creative costs unless you add them.
why_it_matters: Tells you if growth is still profitable.

name: Repeat order share
definition: Share of orders placed by returning customers.
rules: True 90-day repeat rate needs 90+ days of history per cohort. This is the daily proxy.
why_it_matters: Retention health. Cheap to move, expensive to ignore.

name: Refund rate
rules: Attributed to the ORDER date, not the refund date. Real refunds lag, so look back 14 to 30 days when reviewing.
why_it_matters: Catches product, packaging and carrier problems.

name: Average fulfilment time
definition: Hours from order placed to marked fulfilled.
rules: Fulfilled orders only. Orders still unfulfilled are tracked by on_hold_orders and the exceptions SOP.
why_it_matters: Slow fulfilment drives support tickets and refunds.

name: Orders on hold
definition: Orders stuck in on_hold status (fraud review, payment, stock).
why_it_matters: Stuck orders are lost revenue and angry customers.

name: SKUs below reorder point
definition: Number of products with stock under their reorder point.
